title: Bugatti Veyron vs Chiron: The Real Difference

scenes.text: The Bugatti Chiron is the successor to the Bugatti Veyron, and on the surface it is the same recipe: an eight litre, sixteen cylinder, four-turbo engine in a carbon car that costs millions. So what actually changed? We went through Wikipedia, Bugatti's own press release, Carscoops, Top Gear, Car magazine and Motor One, and the answer is both bigger and smaller than you would expect. Here are the numbers, side by side, with every claim sourced.
scenes.caption: BUGATTI VEYRON vs CHIRON: THE REAL DIFFERENCE

scenes.text: We compare the engines, the power, the weight, the speed, the efficiency, the price and the production runs. When a figure is a manufacturer's claim, we say so. When two sources disagree, we show both. And where the numbers need arithmetic, the arithmetic is ours and it is labelled. At the end, we tell you what the sources do not say.
scenes.caption: SOURCES: WIKIPEDIA · BUGATTI PRESS RELEASE (COMPANY SOURCE) · CARSCOOPS · TOP GEAR · CAR MAGAZINE · MOTOR1

scenes.text: Start with what stayed. Wikipedia's Chiron page says the Chiron is the Veyron's successor and that its engine is the Veyron's W sixteen, heavily updated. Both are eight litre, seven thousand nine hundred ninety-three cubic centimetre, quad-turbocharged W sixteens, and both use a seven-speed Ricardo dual-clutch automatic. So the architecture is the same, and the difference lies in how far it was pushed.
scenes.caption: BOTH: 7,993 CC QUAD-TURBO W16 · 7-SPEED RICARDO DUAL-CLUTCH · CHIRON ENGINE = VEYRON'S 'HEAVILY UPDATED' (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: Now what changed. The Veyron is listed at one thousand one metric horsepower and twelve hundred fifty newton-metres, or twelve hundred horsepower and fifteen hundred in the Super Sport. The Chiron is fifteen hundred metric horsepower and sixteen hundred newton-metres, with the Super Sport and the Super Sport three hundred plus at sixteen hundred. Wikipedia lists the Chiron's torque as available from two thousand to six thousand rpm.
scenes.caption: VEYRON 1,001 PS / 1,250 N·M · SUPER SPORT 1,200 PS / 1,500 N·M · CHIRON 1,500 PS / 1,600 N·M · CHIRON SUPER SPORT 1,600 PS (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the Chiron's fifteen hundred is forty-nine point eight percent more power than the Veyron's one thousand one, and twenty-five percent more than the Veyron Super Sport's twelve hundred. In torque, the Chiron's sixteen hundred is twenty-eight percent above the Veyron's twelve fifty, and six point seven percent above the Super Sport's fifteen hundred. So against the Super Sport, the Chiron's gain is smaller than the headline suggests.
scenes.caption: POWER: 1,500 vs 1,001 = +49.8% · vs 1,200 = +25.0% · TORQUE: 1,600 vs 1,250 = +28.0% · vs 1,500 = +6.7% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Wikipedia states the gap directly: the Veyron Super Sport's engine makes two hundred ninety-six horsepower, three hundred metric, less than the Chiron's, and the original Veyron's makes four hundred ninety-two, four hundred ninety-nine metric, less. By our arithmetic, fourteen seventy-nine minus two ninety-six is eleven eighty-three, and minus four ninety-two is nine eighty-seven, which matches the Veyron figures. So the page is internally consistent.
scenes.caption: CHIRON 1,479 HP − 296 = 1,183 HP (SUPER SPORT) · − 492 = 987 HP (ORIGINAL VEYRON) (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The Chiron Super Sport and Super Sport three hundred plus make sixteen hundred metric horsepower, or fifteen hundred seventy-eight horsepower, and Carscoops confirms the Super Sport's figure for the final car. By our arithmetic, that is thirty-three percent more than the Veyron Super Sport's twelve hundred metric, so the best Chiron has a third more power than the best Veyron, in the sources' own numbers.
scenes.caption: CHIRON SUPER SPORT 1,600 PS (1,578 HP) vs VEYRON SUPER SPORT 1,200 PS → +33.3% (WIKIPEDIA, CARSCOOPS; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The Chiron is heavier. Wikipedia lists its kerb weight at one thousand nine hundred ninety-six kilograms, estimated, and the Chiron Sport at one thousand nine hundred seventy-eight. The Veyron's body text gives one thousand eight hundred eighty-eight, with a table range of one thousand eight hundred thirty-eight to one thousand nine hundred ninety. By our arithmetic, the Chiron is one hundred eight kilograms, or five point seven percent, heavier than the Veyron's stated figure.
scenes.caption: CHIRON 1,996 KG (EST.) · CHIRON SPORT 1,978 KG · VEYRON 1,888 KG (RANGE 1,838–1,990) → +108 KG (+5.7%) (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Note the top of the Veyron's range: one thousand nine hundred ninety kilograms is only six kilograms lighter than the Chiron's one thousand nine hundred ninety-six. So depending on which Veyron figure you use, the weight difference is anywhere from six kilograms to about a hundred and fifty-eight. Wikipedia does not explain the Veyron's range, and the Chiron's number is an estimate, so we call the weight gap uncertain.
scenes.caption: VEYRON RANGE 1,838–1,990 KG vs CHIRON 1,996 KG → GAP 6 TO 158 KG (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC) — UNCERTAIN

scenes.text: The power-to-weight ratio is clearer. Using the base figures, the Chiron's fourteen seventy-nine horsepower over one point nine nine six tonnes is about seven hundred forty-one horsepower per tonne. The Veyron's nine eighty-seven over one point eight eight eight is about five hundred twenty-three. By our arithmetic, the Chiron is forty-two percent better. Weight went up a little, power went up a lot.
scenes.query: Chiron vs Veyron power to weight
scenes.caption: CHIRON 1,479 ÷ 1.996 t ≈ 741 HP/t · VEYRON 987 ÷ 1.888 t ≈ 523 HP/t → +41.7% (OUR ARITHMETIC FROM WIKIPEDIA FIGURES)

scenes.text: Size. Wikipedia lists the Veyron's length at four thousand four hundred sixty-two millimetres, or one hundred seventy-five point seven inches, and the Chiron's at four thousand five hundred forty-four, with a width of two thousand thirty-eight, a height of twelve hundred twelve and a wheelbase of twenty-seven hundred eleven. By our arithmetic, the Chiron is eighty-two millimetres longer, about three point two inches. A small step for a very different car.
scenes.caption: LENGTH: VEYRON 4,462 MM (175.7 IN) · CHIRON 4,544 MM → +82 MM (≈ 3.2 IN) · CHIRON WIDTH 2,038 · HEIGHT 1,212 · WHEELBASE 2,711 MM (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: Acceleration. Wikipedia lists the Veyron at zero to one hundred in two point four six seconds. The Chiron's manufacturer claims are zero to one hundred in two point four, zero to two hundred in six point five and zero to three hundred in thirteen point six. The Veyron Super Sport is listed at zero to two hundred in six point seven. By our arithmetic, the Chiron's gain over the Super Sport at two hundred is only two tenths, or three percent.
scenes.caption: 0–100: 2.46 s (VEYRON) vs 2.4 s (CHIRON CLAIM) · 0–200: 6.7 s (VEYRON SS) vs 6.5 s (CHIRON) = −0.2 s (−3.0%) · 0–300: 13.6 s (CHIRON) (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: The Chiron Super Sport is quicker. Wikipedia gives zero to two hundred in five point eight seconds and zero to three hundred in twelve point one. By our arithmetic, the Super Sport's zero to two hundred is nine tenths faster than the Veyron Super Sport's six point seven, or thirteen percent. That is the real acceleration gain between the two generations, and it comes with the biggest power.
scenes.caption: CHIRON SUPER SPORT: 0–200 IN 5.8 s · 0–300 IN 12.1 s (WIKIPEDIA) · vs VEYRON SS 6.7 s = −0.9 s (−13.4%) (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Now top speed. The Veyron's record, per Wikipedia, was four hundred eight point four seven kilometres per hour for the original and four hundred thirty-one point oh seven two for the Super Sport. The Chiron Super Sport three hundred plus reached four hundred ninety point four eight four, or three hundred four point seven seven three miles per hour, on the second of August, twenty nineteen, driven by Andy Wallace at Ehra-Lessien and verified by TÜV.
scenes.caption: VEYRON 408.47 / SUPER SPORT 431.072 KM/H · CHIRON SS 300+ 490.484 KM/H (304.773 MPH), AUG 2, 2019, ANDY WALLACE, TÜV-VERIFIED (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the Chiron run is fifty-nine point four kilometres per hour, thirteen point eight percent, faster than the Veyron Super Sport's record, and eighty-two kilometres per hour, twenty percent, faster than the original Veyron. In miles per hour, three hundred four point seven seven three minus two hundred sixty-seven point eight five six is thirty-six point nine one seven. That is the biggest single gap in this comparison.
scenes.query: Chiron vs Veyron top speed gap
scenes.caption: 490.484 − 431.072 = 59.41 KM/H (+13.8%) · − 408.47 = 82.01 KM/H (+20.1%) · 304.773 − 267.856 = 36.917 MPH (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: A caveat on that run. Carscoops calls the three hundred four point seven seven three miles per hour figure the Chiron's unofficial top speed record, set at Ehra-Lessien in twenty nineteen, and notes it was the first production model to pass three hundred. Bugatti, in its press release, says the Chiron was the first production car to surpass three hundred. The run used a pre-production prototype, per Wikipedia, so its status is debated.
scenes.caption: 'UNOFFICIAL' RECORD (CARSCOOPS) · 'FIRST PRODUCTION CAR TO SURPASS 300 MPH' (BUGATTI PRESS RELEASE) · PRE-PRODUCTION PROTOTYPE (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: The limits. Wikipedia says the standard Chiron's electronic top speed is limited to four hundred twenty kilometres per hour, two hundred sixty-one miles per hour, or three hundred seventy-five to three hundred eighty without the specific key, and that the Super Sport three hundred plus is limited to four hundred forty, two hundred seventy-three point four miles per hour, in production form. The Veyron Super Sport is limited to four hundred fifteen.
scenes.caption: CHIRON LIMIT 420 KM/H (261 MPH) · 375–380 KM/H WITHOUT THE KEY · SUPER SPORT 300+ 440 KM/H (273.4 MPH) · VEYRON SUPER SPORT 415 KM/H (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: So the key idea survived. Both cars have a top-speed key, in the sources, and both are limited by software. By our arithmetic, the Chiron's limit of four hundred twenty is five kilometres per hour above the Veyron Super Sport's four hundred fifteen, and the Chiron Super Sport's four hundred forty is twenty-five above. The big jump from limit to limit is smaller than the jump between the record runs.
scenes.caption: 420 − 415 = 5 KM/H · 440 − 415 = 25 KM/H (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Wikipedia also lists a 2017 Chiron test of zero to four hundred kilometres per hour in thirty-two point six seconds, then braked to a stop in nine point four. At the IAA in twenty seventeen, driver Juan Pablo Montoya did zero to four hundred to zero in forty-one point nine six seconds at Ehra-Lessien. By our arithmetic, thirty-two point six plus nine point four is forty-two, which matches within four hundredths.
scenes.caption: 2017: 0–400 KM/H IN 32.6 s + BRAKING 9.4 s ≈ 42.0 s · IAA 2017: 41.96 s, JUAN PABLO MONTOYA (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Fuel. Wikipedia lists the Chiron's mixed consumption at twenty-two point five litres per hundred kilometres, ten point four five miles per gallon. Bugatti's press release gives the Chiron Super Sport at twenty-one point five litres per hundred kilometres combined on the WLTP cycle, with emissions of four hundred eighty-seven grams of carbon dioxide per kilometre and efficiency class G. The Veyron's EPA figures are eight city, fourteen highway.
scenes.caption: CHIRON 22.5 L/100 KM (10.45 MPG) MIXED (WIKIPEDIA) · SUPER SPORT 21.5 L/100 KM WLTP, 487 G/KM CO₂, CLASS G (BUGATTI) · VEYRON EPA 8 CITY / 14 HIGHWAY MPG

scenes.text: Convert for a fair comparison. By our arithmetic, eight miles per gallon is about 29.4 litres per hundred kilometres, and fourteen is 16.8. The Chiron's mixed 22.5 sits between them. The cycles are different, a mixed figure against EPA city and highway, so it is not a like-for-like test, and the Chiron is certainly not a frugal car, but we cannot say it uses more or less than the Veyron overall.
scenes.caption: 8 MPG ≈ 29.4 L/100 KM · 14 MPG ≈ 16.8 L/100 KM · CHIRON 22.5 L/100 KM MIXED — DIFFERENT CYCLES, NOT LIKE FOR LIKE (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Top speed fuel use is a similar story. The Veyron's EPA figure of three miles per gallon at top speed, one point four gallons a minute, comes from Wikipedia. We found no equivalent figure for the Chiron in our sources. So we cannot say whether the Chiron drinks faster at its limit, only that it makes more power, and so probably needs the air and fuel for it. That last part is our inference.
scenes.caption: VEYRON: 3 MPG, 1.4 GAL/MIN AT TOP SPEED (WIKIPEDIA) · CHIRON: NO EQUIVALENT FIGURE IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Prices. Wikipedia lists the Veyron's base at one million, two hundred twenty-five thousand euros for the standard and Grand Sport, and one million, nine hundred twelve thousand, five hundred for the Super Sport and Vitesse. The Chiron's base price was two million, four hundred thousand euros, with a two hundred thousand euro deposit. By our arithmetic, the Chiron is ninety-six percent above the standard Veyron, and twenty-five and a half percent above the Super Sport.
scenes.caption: VEYRON €1,225,000 / SUPER SPORT €1,912,500 · CHIRON €2,400,000 (+€200,000 DEPOSIT) → +95.9% / +25.5% (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The Chiron's variants cost more. Wikipedia says the Chiron Sport was about four hundred thousand dollars above the standard Chiron. The Super Sport three hundred plus cost three and a half million euros net, the Super Sport about three point two million net, and the Noire about three point three million dollars. By our arithmetic, the Super Sport three hundred plus is forty-six percent above the Chiron's base price in euros.
scenes.caption: SPORT +$400,000 · SUPER SPORT 300+ €3.5M NET · SUPER SPORT ~€3.2M NET · NOIR ~$3.3M · 300+ = +45.8% vs €2.4M BASE (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Production. The Veyron: four hundred fifty over more than ten years, with the last car sold in May twenty fourteen, Wikipedia says. The Chiron: five hundred, with the first two hundred sold before the first delivery in March twenty seventeen, all sold by January twenty twenty-two, the last base-spec car built in September twenty twenty-three, and production ended in May twenty twenty-four with L'Ultime, the five hundredth.
scenes.caption: VEYRON 450 (LAST SOLD MAY 2014) · CHIRON 500: FIRST 200 SOLD BEFORE MARCH 2017 DELIVERY · ALL SOLD JAN 2022 · ENDED MAY 2024 (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: Bugatti's press release dated the thirtieth of May, twenty twenty-four confirms L'Ultime is the five hundredth and last Chiron, a Chiron Super Sport, hand-assembled in Molsheim. Carscoops adds that the run lasted eight years, beginning at the twenty sixteen Geneva Motor Show, and that Bugatti itself hedges with: or so they say, because you never know with Bugatti. It also notes Bugatti said it no longer plans to chase speed records.
scenes.caption: MAY 30, 2024: L'ULTIME = 500TH AND LAST CHIRON, A SUPER SPORT, MOLSHEIM (BUGATTI) · RUN 2016–2024 · 'NO LONGER PLANS TO CHASE SPEED RECORDS' (CARSCOOPS)

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, five hundred against four hundred fifty is eleven percent more cars. But the Chiron family was spread over many versions: Wikipedia lists the Sport at sixty, the Pur Sport at sixty, the Super Sport at seventy to eighty, the three hundred plus at thirty, and several of twenty or fewer. A buyer wanting a specific Chiron variant faced a much rarer car than the headline five hundred suggests.
scenes.caption: 500 vs 450 = +11.1% · SPORT 60 · PUR SPORT 60 · SUPER SPORT ~70–80 · 300+ 30 · 110 ANS 20 · NOIRE 20 · LES LÉGENDES DU CIEL 20 (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The Veyron's economics are known only roughly. Motor One says Volkswagen reportedly lost about six point two five million dollars on each of the four hundred fifty it sold, and Jalopnik traces the figure to an Economist infographic. We found no equivalent report for the Chiron. So we cannot compare the profitability of the two generations, only their prices and their numbers.
scenes.caption: VEYRON: ~$6.25M LOSS PER CAR (MOTOR1; JALOPNIK CITING THE ECONOMIST) · CHIRON: NO EQUIVALENT FIGURE IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Rarity at auction. Wikipedia says a one-off Chiron Profilée sold for nine million, seven hundred ninety-two thousand, five hundred euros at auction in February twenty twenty-three, and the one-off La Voiture Noire sold for nine and a half million pounds. By our arithmetic, the Profilée is four times the Chiron's base price. Those are unique cars, not typical ones, so we mention them only as the top of the range.
scenes.caption: PROFILÉE: €9,792,500 AT AUCTION (FEB 2023) · LA VOITURE NOIRE: £9.5M · PROFILÉE ≈ 4.1× €2.4M BASE (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Timing. Wikipedia says Veyron production began in September two thousand five and the last car, number four hundred fifty, was sold in May twenty fourteen. Carscoops says the Chiron run began at the twenty sixteen Geneva Motor Show, and Wikipedia says deliveries began in March twenty seventeen. By our arithmetic, that is two years and ten months between the last Veyron sale and the first Chiron delivery.
scenes.caption: VEYRON PRODUCTION SEPT 2005 → LAST SOLD MAY 2014 · CHIRON GENEVA 2016 → FIRST DELIVERY MARCH 2017 · GAP ≈ 2 YEARS 10 MONTHS (WIKIPEDIA, CARSCOOPS; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Pace. The Chiron's run, from the March twenty seventeen deliveries to May twenty twenty-four, is about seven years and two months, so five hundred cars means roughly seventy a year, by our arithmetic. The Veyron's, from September two thousand five to May twenty fourteen, is about eight years and eight months, so four hundred fifty means roughly fifty-two a year. The Chiron was built a little faster, on these dates.
scenes.caption: CHIRON ≈ 500 ÷ 7.2 YRS ≈ 70/YEAR · VEYRON ≈ 450 ÷ 8.7 YRS ≈ 52/YEAR (OUR ARITHMETIC; DATES FROM WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: Both ran on the same W sixteen. By our arithmetic, from September two thousand five to May twenty twenty-four is eighteen years and eight months of W sixteen production. Carscoops says the successor, expected in June twenty twenty-four, replaces the quad-turbo W sixteen with a naturally aspirated V sixteen with hybrid assistance. So this comparison is also a farewell to an engine design.
scenes.caption: W16 PRODUCTION SEPT 2005 → MAY 2024 ≈ 18 YEARS 8 MONTHS (OUR ARITHMETIC) · SUCCESSOR: NATURALLY ASPIRATED V16 + HYBRID (CARSCOOPS)

scenes.text: The Chiron Sport shows the direction of the changes. Wikipedia says it is eighteen kilograms lighter, with sixty built, and costs about four hundred thousand dollars more. The Pur Sport is fifty kilograms lighter, sixty built, with the redline raised to sixty-nine hundred rpm. By our arithmetic, eighteen kilograms is nine tenths of a percent of the Chiron's weight, and fifty is two and a half percent.
scenes.caption: SPORT: −18 KG (−0.9%), 60 UNITS, +$400,000 · PUR SPORT: −50 KG (−2.5%), 60 UNITS, REDLINE 6,900 RPM (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Those figures are modest. A Chiron Sport that is nine tenths of a percent lighter for four hundred thousand dollars is an object lesson in what extra money buys at this level. By our arithmetic, four hundred thousand over eighteen kilograms is twenty-two thousand two hundred dollars per kilogram saved. We do not claim the Sport was only about weight, because Wikipedia lists no other changes.
scenes.caption: $400,000 ÷ 18 KG ≈ $22,222 PER KG SAVED (OUR ARITHMETIC) · OTHER SPORT CHANGES: NOT LISTED IN OUR SOURCE

scenes.text: Price per horsepower. By our arithmetic, the base Veyron at one million, two hundred twenty-five thousand euros over nine hundred eighty-seven horsepower is about twelve hundred forty-one euros per horsepower. The base Chiron at two point four million over fourteen seventy-nine is about sixteen hundred twenty-three. The Chiron Super Sport at three point two million over fifteen seventy-eight is about two thousand twenty-eight. Each step upmarket cost more per horsepower.
scenes.query: Veyron and Chiron price per horsepower
scenes.caption: VEYRON €1.225M ÷ 987 ≈ €1,241/HP · CHIRON €2.4M ÷ 1,479 ≈ €1,623/HP · CHIRON SUPER SPORT €3.2M ÷ 1,578 ≈ €2,028/HP (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Long-distance acceleration. Wikipedia lists the Veyron Super Sport's zero to four hundred time as an estimate of forty seconds, and a Chiron test of thirty-two point six. By our arithmetic, that is seven point four seconds, or eighteen and a half percent, quicker. But one is an estimate and the other a measured test, from different cars, so we flag it as indicative, not as a head-to-head result.
scenes.caption: VEYRON SS 0–400 ≈ 40 s (ESTIMATE) vs CHIRON 32.6 s (TEST) → −7.4 s (−18.5%) — NOT A HEAD-TO-HEAD (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Emissions. Bugatti's press release lists four hundred eighty-seven grams of carbon dioxide per kilometre combined for the Chiron Super Sport, class G. By our arithmetic, that is just under five tonnes of carbon dioxide for every ten thousand kilometres driven. The Veyron's sources give no emissions figure. We include the number only because the press release itself lists it, and to show how heavy the numbers get.
scenes.caption: 487 G/KM CO₂ × 10,000 KM ≈ 4.87 TONNES (BUGATTI WLTP FIGURE; OUR ARITHMETIC) · VEYRON: NO EMISSIONS FIGURE IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Stiffness is another claim. Wikipedia says the Chiron's body stiffness is fifty thousand newton-metres per degree. The Veyron's sources give no equivalent number, so we cannot compare the two. We mention it because stiffness is one of the places where a new generation of carbon car can improve on an old one, but the sources do not tell us how much the Chiron improved.
scenes.caption: CHIRON BODY STIFFNESS 50,000 N·M PER DEGREE (WIKIPEDIA) · VEYRON: NO EQUIVALENT FIGURE IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: The market responded. Wikipedia says the first two hundred Chirons were sold before the first delivery, and all five hundred were sold by January twenty twenty-two. By our arithmetic, that is four years and ten months after deliveries began, and about two years and four months before production ended. So the last cars were built after the whole run had already been sold.
scenes.caption: FIRST 200 SOLD BEFORE MARCH 2017 · ALL SOLD JAN 2022 (≈ 4 YRS 10 MONTHS AFTER DELIVERIES BEGAN) · PRODUCTION ENDED MAY 2024 (≈ 2 YRS 4 MONTHS LATER) (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Variants show how Bugatti sold the same car again. Wikipedia lists the one hundred ten Ans Bugatti, twenty units, in February twenty nineteen, the Les Légendes du Ciel, twenty units at two point eight eight million euros each, the Noire, twenty units at about three point three million dollars, and the Pur Sport Grand Prix, one unit. By our arithmetic, those four alone are sixty-one cars, a small share of the five hundred.
scenes.caption: 110 ANS 20 · LES LÉGENDES DU CIEL 20 (€2.88M EACH) · NOIRE 20 (~$3.3M) · PUR SPORT GRAND PRIX 1 = 61 CARS (WIKIPEDIA; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: A word on the Chiron's cousins. Wikipedia says the Super Sport three hundred plus and the Centodieci share the sixteen hundred metric horsepower engine, and that the Mistral is a W sixteen car that sold out. The Divo and others get no specifications on the page. So the family beyond the Chiron is real but poorly described in our sources, and we leave it out rather than guess.
scenes.caption: CENTODIECI SHARES THE 1,600 PS ENGINE · MISTRAL: W16, SOLD OUT · DIVO ETC.: NO SPECS IN OUR SOURCE (WIKIPEDIA)

scenes.text: Put it together. The Chiron is the same engine family, pushed from one thousand one to fifteen hundred metric horsepower, heavier by about a hundred kilograms on the figures we have, faster by tenths in the quarter of a minute that matters, and, in its Super Sport three hundred plus form, thirty-seven miles per hour faster at the top. And it costs nearly twice as much as the entry Veyron.
scenes.caption: +50% POWER · ~+108 KG · 0–200 −0.2 s (BASE) / −0.9 s (SUPER SPORT) · TOP SPEED RUN +36.9 MPH · PRICE +96% (OUR ARITHMETIC FROM WIKIPEDIA FIGURES)

scenes.text: Which is the better car? The sources do not say. They say the Chiron is the faster and more powerful of the two, and the Veyron was the first. Gordon Murray, quoted by Motor One, called the Veyron a massive technical achievement. Bugatti, in its own press release, says the Chiron was the first production car to surpass three hundred miles per hour. Each has its own claim.
scenes.caption: VEYRON: 408.47 KM/H AT LAUNCH (MURRAY: 'MASSIVE TECHNICAL ACHIEVEMENT') · CHIRON: 'FIRST PRODUCTION CAR TO SURPASS 300 MPH' (BUGATTI)

scenes.text: What our sources do not say. They do not give a Chiron fuel figure at top speed. They do not give a Chiron tyre life or tyre price, though the Veyron's PAX tyres cost twenty-five thousand dollars a set. They do not give a clean Chiron weight, since Wikipedia's is an estimate. And they do not say whether Bugatti's new Tourbillon will beat the Chiron, because the release only mentions it.
scenes.caption: NOT IN OUR SOURCES: CHIRON TOP-SPEED FUEL USE · TYRE LIFE/PRICE · MEASURED WEIGHT · TOURBILLON PERFORMANCE

scenes.text: Which would you rather have, the pioneering Veyron or the faster Chiron? Tell us in the comments. In the other videos of this series, we reveal two things you did not know about the Veyron, count what it really costs to own one, and tell why it almost never happened. Our twenty twenty-seven Truck Buyer's Guide is linked in the description. Subscribe to Pickup Reality.
scenes.caption: SUBSCRIBE: PICKUP REALITY
